name: webcam-usb
title: USB Camera
author: bespoked
description: Registers an external USB camera as a Moonraker [webcam] entry. WebRTC stream from /webcam2/webrtc, JPEG snapshots from /webcam2/snapshot.jpg. Requires the Camera HW Accel plugin to actually serve those URLs.
tagline: Show the external USB camera in Fluidd & Mainsail.

variables.name: USB_CAMERA_NAME
variables.description: Display name for the external USB camera in Fluidd/Mainsail (e.g. "USB", "External", "Bed View").

config.label: Camera name in Fluidd/Mainsail
config.hint: Whatever you want it called in the UI: USB, External, Bed View, etc.
